title: A Alibi for the Verdict Revisited
author: Petra Dravenmoor
blurb: Isandro Eriksen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
